PC: Place patient on monitor by attaching leads to chest
Place patient on supplementary oxygen via nasal prongs or facemask
Perform limited physical examination of patient
Prepare equipment and insert IV line
Commence IV fluid infusion using pump
Roll patient to clean soiling and dispose of soiled material appropriately
SBP: All waste – including linens, unused medications, and sealed sharps container(s) – will be placed into red biohazard waste containers.
Red biohazard waste containers should be lined with 2 red bags.
½ a container of Premisorb should be poured in the bottom of the inner bag.
Red biohazard waste containers are considered “full” when they are ¾ full.
Apply (spray) enough bleach-based disinfectant into the red bag to sufficiently cover the surface of the waste.
Securely tie the first red bag.
Securely tie the second red bag.
Lift the red bag out of the red biohazard waste container and wipe the exterior surface with bleach-based disinfectant (Dispatch wipes).
Place tied red bag into the 32-gallon Brute Barrel just outside of the Patient Care Room door (by the Doffing Room).
Transport the full 32-gallon Brute Barrel to the threshold of Room 8/Room 9. ESD staff will process the waste from this point.
Return to Patient Care Room and re-line the empty red biohazard waste containers with 2 red bags and pour ½ a container of Premisorb into the bottom of the inner bag.
Make sure that you are wearing shoe covers and put on a third pair of gloves
Get Premisorb, a trash container, Dispatch wipes, Dispatch spray container, flat mop, and two sets (4 pieces) of yellow laminated sheets
Sprinkle Premisorb to cover the spill
Wait approximately 1 minute for solidification
With one piece in each hand, use the yellow laminated sheets to scrape up the now solidified spill and throw it in the trash container
Repeat until the area is cleared of body fluid
Use a second set of yellow laminated sheets if the first set is not strong enough
Throw the yellow laminated sheets in the trash container – be careful not to step in the contaminated area or extra Premisorb
Wet the area and extra Premisorb with Dispatch spray
With the flat mop, wipe the floor in a circular motion to remove the extra Premisorb and to disinfect the area
Let the area dry
Bring flat mop to entrance of Doffing Room
Place flat mop in Brute barrel in Doffing Room
Disinfect gloves with Dispatch wipes
Remove the outermost pair of gloves and discard
If staff cleaning up a spill outside of patient room, remove the shoe covers, disinfect outer gloves with Dispatch wipes, remove, and discard
Staff will discard flat mop head, disinfect mop handle
ICS: Communicate clearly and consistently with colleague and patient
Make sure that staff is prepared
